evidence.quote: Term sheet: class fund $30,000,000; attorneys' fees $6,000,000; clear sailing no

evidence.agent: Hargrove Lane LLP declaration to court
evidence.quote: The fee terms were discussed alongside class relief from the outset, not only after class relief had been agreed.
Use the same offer across counsel because any one approved settlement releases the entire class.
Hargrove’s latest demand is the closest to an acceptable total, so make it the strongest offer; make lower but credible offers to the other firms.

summary: Plaintiff counsel first raised fees in its opening term sheet, and fees were negotiated alongside class relief before any class-relief-only agreement was reached. The record does not show plaintiff counsel sacrificing class value for its own fees, especially because compensation was fixed and no clear-sailing term was used. Defense did use overlapping counsel dynamics by tailoring stronger offers to the closest/cheapest counsel where any approved settlement would release the entire class. The court declaration is consistent with the transcript and is not materially misleading.
